quests.name: Cook's Assistant
quests.start: Speak to the Cook in the kitchen of Lumbridge Castle.

steps.text: Talk to the Cook in Lumbridge Castle's kitchen.

spot.label: Wait till the Cook is here

steps.text: Pick up a pot from next to the Cook.
Buy a compost from Fayeth at the farming patch west of the castle. Empty the compost to receive a bucket.
Run north to Fred the Farmer and grab the Egg that spawns in front of his house.
Pick some grain from the wheat outside the Mill Lane Mill.
Climb up to the top floor of the mill and use the grain on the hopper. Climbing the east side of the ladder saves 2 ticks.
Pull the lever (the hopper controls).
Climb down and take the flour from the flour bin with your empty pot.
Run north into the cow pen and milk the dairy cow.
Begin casting Lumbridge Home Teleport as soon as the milk appears in your inventory, and run to the cook.
Talk to the Cook.

tips.heading: General
paragraphs: Pathing manually to climb the east side of the mill's ladder on the way up and down will save 2 ticks.
Starting the quest with the Cook in a good spot where you can instantly grab the pot can save 1 tick.
After the first line of dialogue with the Cook, you can use your egg on him while holding space to give him two items during the same tick, saving 1 tick.
A combination of luck for where you spawn after home teleporting and where the cook is standing can save 2 ticks.

tips.heading: Chickens
paragraphs: When poisoned, instead of getting poisoned, some monsters will start their internal timer. For chickens, this timer makes them lay an egg every so often. Getting an alt to poison 2 chickens before your run and positioning them on the path can save a few seconds.

To set up a poison alt, load A Kingdom Divided and go into the catacombs. Run south to the ankou and afk them until you get a weapon poison drop. Lower your stats at the nearby aberrant spectres so you do not kill the chickens. Get a dagger at the warriors' guild and poison it.

(Not recommended) A dragon spear is not easily obtainable, but can be used to lure a chicken onto the bridge across the river lum, allowing you to milk the closer cow in the east pen, in combination with a pot of flour drop.

tips.heading: Imps
paragraphs: Monsters damaged by you will still be damaged after restarting a speedrun. Ironman rules still apply, so another player cannot deal damage to it. This means you can damage an imp down to 1 hp before the run starts, position it near Fayeth, start the run, then punch the imp to death when the run starts for a low chance at a pot of flour, egg, or bucket.
An alt can splash on the imp to hold it in place better. A splashing alt can be set up easily by loading the Dragon Slayer II preset and getting vambraces at the Champions' Guild.

After you press to start the quest speedrun, but before the timer starts, if an imp dies its loot will not disappear when the run starts. With good timing and precise imp positioning, you can cast a spell, then start the dialogue with the Cook. If you're fast enough, the imp will die after you press 1. Then you can wait around and make sure a chicken laid an egg before starting the run if you got a pot of flour drop.

quests.name: Vampyre Slayer
quests.start: Speak to Morgan in his house in Draynor Village, just north of Ned's house.

steps.text: Go upstairs in Morgan's house and open the cupboard. Then go back downstairs.
Decide on which weapon to use for the final fight. The most viable options are:
notes: Goblin paint cannon, a 3-tick Melee weapon without stats. It is fast and the quickest to obtain as it can be bought from Diango together with the Chronicle, but not as powerful as the other options. Potentially the fastest option.
Adamant sword, the strongest option. While the strongest option, it takes the longest to obtain as it has to be bought in the Varrock Sword Shop.
Training Bow, a Ranged alternative which can be claimed from the Ranged combat tutor along the path to the general store.

steps.text: Talk to Morgan in Draynor Village about a vampyre.

chat.text: Ok, I'm up for an adventure.

steps.text: Go upstairs in Morgan's house and take garlic from the cupboard.
Go back downstairs and run to Diango in Draynor Village Market and purchase a Chronicle and a Teleport Card.
notes: If choosing to fight Count Draynor with melee using a Goblin paint cannon, buy it from Diango now (Skip claiming the bow and arrows from the Ranged combat tutor later on).
Use the Teleport Card on the Chronicle to give it 1 charge.

steps.text: Teleport using the chronicle to go to the Champions Guild.
notes: If choosing to fight Count Draynor with melee using an adamant sword, buy it from the sword shop across the street from the Blue Moon Inn now (Skip claiming the bow and arrows from the Ranged combat tutor later on).

steps.text: Go to the Blue Moon Inn and buy a beer from the Bartender.

chat.text: A glass of your finest ale please.

steps.text: Talk to Dr Harlow. After he asks for a beer the second time, you can safely click out of the dialogue.
Talk to Dr Harlow again and receive a stake.
Cast Lumbridge Home Teleport and go to the Ranged combat tutor and claim items.
After receiving your Training Bow purchase a hammer from the Lumbridge General Store.
Run to Draynor Manor and enter through the back entrance.
notes: Make sure to equip your bow and arrows or Goblin paint cannon while running there.
The back door entrance is on the south-east side of Draynor Manor and leads directly into the kitchen.

steps.text: Go downstairs directly next to the kitchen.
Open the coffin and kill Count Draynor. (You do not need to use the hammer/stake on him. Just kill him with them in your inventory)
notes: This part is RNG dependent. It is recommended to put your bow on Rapid and activate Hawk Eye prayer or your Goblin paint cannon on Accurate and activate Improved Reflexes prayer.

Climb down the ladder and complete the lever puzzle.

Pull lever D down.

Exit out the back door in the same room.
Go north around the back of the manor to the west to the compost heap.

Drop the spade to save run energy
Go south and use the poisoned fish food on the fountain in the south-west corner of the grounds.
Search the poisoned fountain to retrieve a pressure gauge. (There is dialogue here while searching so hold space bar).

quests.name: Demon Slayer
quests.start: Speak to Aris in the tent on the western side of Varrock Square.

steps.text: Set NPC 'Attack' Options to "Always right-click" under Settings > Control Settings to prevent accidentally targeting the Giant rats when collecting bones
Enable "Shift drop" under All Settings > Controls to quickly drop items
Select Logout > World Switcher. Sort by the fourth column to show speedrunning worlds, and disable the warning message for hopping.
Pre-open Varrock Palace (castle) doors (optional)
Set the Grouping menu to teleport to Soul Wars.
Talk to Aris just south-west of Varrock Square.
notes: Note: Make sure you note down the incantation said during the cutscene! The order will also change with every reset. The speedrunning timer will not start until the cutscene ends.
It can be helpful to note the sequence dialogue option numbers corresponding to the incantation as well: 1 - Carlem; 2 - Aber; 3 - Camerinthum; 4 - Purchai; 5 - Gabindo.

chat.text: How am I meant to fight a demon who can destroy cities?
So how did Wally kill Delrith?

Talk to Sir Prysin in the south-west room of the castle with the training dummy.

chat.text: Aris said I should come and talk to you.

And why is this a problem?

chat.text: Yes I know, but this is important.

It's not them who are going to fight the demon, it's me.

Climb down the manhole to the Varrock Sewers east of the castle, outside the wall.

Follow the path slightly west, then start running north. While running, select Soul Wars from the Grouping tab and drink an energy potion. Drop any empty vials. Continue down to the end and pick up the rusty key from the floor. Hit space bar quickly to dismiss the dialogue when picking up the key.

Drink another energy potion and drop the vials. You should now have 25 empty inventory spaces, coins, and 2 energy potions.
Run briefly north, and collect the three bones against the walls.
notes: The bones are located in the south-west corner, slightly north along the wall, and just east before the northern passage. Turn your camera to see the bones in the south-west corner if you are having difficulty.

steps.text: Run east to reach a small room with 3 Giant rats and four bone spawns. Pick them up and prepare to hop worlds. Be careful not to attack the Giant rats as you will not be able to world-hop immediately!

Note: The timer does not stop when hopping worlds.

steps.text: Hop worlds and continue to collect the 4 bones until you have 25. Immediately use Lumbridge Home Teleport.
Run west through the Lumbridge Castle to get to Draynor Village, drinking any extra energy potions and dropping empty vials if you can.

While running/walking to Draynor Village bank, set up your offensive quick prayers such as Superhuman Strength and Improved Reflexes. Walk for approximately 8-10 seconds since the weight of the bones will drain run energy faster. Keeping 5-10 run energy by walking here is recommended if you want more consistent timing against the fight with Delrith while resetting aggression from the Dark wizards.
Use the Draynor Village bank and withdraw both the rusty key and first key.
Run to Diango and drop 3 bones before trading with him.
Buy a Chronicle and two teleport cards. Add the teleport charges to the Chronicle and wield it.
Drop your coins, then pick up the 3 bones you dropped.

steps.text: Run to the Wizards' Tower directly south of Draynor Village bank.
Climb the spiral staircase once upwards to the 1st floor, then talk to Wizard Traiborn in the eastern room..

chat.text: I need to get a key given to you by Sir Prysin
Well, have you got any keys knocking around?

As soon as you get the third key, use your wielded Chronicle to teleport to the Champions' Guild.

Run back to Sir Prysin in Varrock Palace in the south-west room with the training dummy. Talk to him; a brief stall will occur while he gets retrieves it from the cabinet nearby. He will give you Silverlight and it will automatically equip.

notes: The upcoming fight takes place in a single-way combat zone. Any attack by the Dark wizards will prevent you from attacking Delrith. Read below for more information, and be prepared to reset aggression multiple times if needed.

steps.text: Run to the Stone Circle south of Varrock. Stay to the south.

Activate your quick prayers when you get close to the stone circle. Run along the eastern edge of the southern-most section of the circle, on top of the stones, to begin a cutscene. Complete all cutscene dialogue or you will have to re-watch it!

Well... that's an interesting thought. Yes, I think I could do something. Give me three balls of wool and I might be able to do it.

tips.heading: Mining
paragraphs: Clicking to mine with a bronze pickaxe will start an 8 tick timer, at the end of which your character will have a chance to mine a rock. This is the same skilling timer as most other skilling and combat options, so with some clever routing you can reduce your wait quite a bit. You will start your skilling timer on some other action, then arrive at a rock when the skilling timer is about to end.

To do this, you will click on this tree without an axe. This sets your skilling timer to 3. You then run for 4 ticks to the tin rock. If you eat a tuna on the way, you can add a 3 tick delay to your skilling timer and arrive at the rock at the right time. Once the tin ore is mined, you can eat another tuna and immediately click the clay rock. This adds 3 to your skilling timer and takes 1 tick to move there, which works perfectly.

tips.heading: Alts
paragraphs: Alts can help with mining similarly to above. If you lure a unicorn, you can punch it at a good time on the way to the copper rock, saving 7 ticks.
There are a lot of NPCs in this quest with decently large wander ranges. Here is the order of preference you would want to use an alt to hold them to save the most time on average:
• Unicorn
• Thesselia
• Aggie
• Ned
• Chancellor Hassan
• Joe + Keli (same alt can hold both, though need to be careful and retalk during minigame tele)
• Shop keeper
• Mugger
• Osman
• Leela
• Prince Ali

tips.heading: Deathwarping
paragraphs: With very good luck, you can die to the guards while picking nettles at the end to save a little bit of time. On average, this method is a bit slower than the Giants' Foundry teleport, but with the best hit RNG it will save time. Note that you do not need 10gp to get through the gate after you have saved Prince Ali.

Dying faster means getting back to Lumbridge faster. When picking nettles, you want to make sure both guards are able to hit you. By picking the north nettle, then switching to the nettle one south, then back to the north one, you can make sure the guards aren't stacked on each other.

quests.name: Below Ice Mountain
quests.start: Willow on the path south of Ice Mountain

Talk to Willow.

Buy an Asgarnian ale from Kaylee.

steps.text: Use the Chronicle teleport.
While running to Charlie the Tramp, use the bowl of water on a pot of flour.
Speak to Charlie the Tramp south of the Varrock Swordshop.

chat.text: I'm looking for a man named Marley. Have you seen him?

steps.text: Speak to the cook in the east room of Blue Moon Inn in Varrock.

notes: If you burned the bread, use the house in west Edgeville to refill your bowl and cook a new bread.

steps.text: Use the Grouping menu to teleport to Soul Wars.
Use the portal there to travel to Edgeville.

Run south to Barbarian Village.
Speak to Checkal in Barbarian Village near the pottery oven building.

Speak to Atlas in The Long Hall tavern in Barbarian Village and complete the (very long) training montage.

steps.text: Stand near Checkal and use the Flex emote, then finish the dialogue.
Go to the entrance of the Ruins of Camdozaal, at the west side of the Ice Mountain, and talk to Willow (dungeon icon on minimap).
notes: Take a sip of stamina potion while running. Also equip the pickaxe.

steps.text: After the cutscene, kill the level 25 Ancient Guardian by mining the 4 pillars in the corners.
notes: Simply mining all four pillars will be fast enough to get platinum.
To slightly speed up the kill, alternate between attacking the Ancient Guardian and mining a pillar.
Equip the bronze pickaxe, set it to Smash, and activate Superhuman Strength and Improved Reflexes.
Attacking will set your skilling timer favourably to allow you to mine the pillar in fewer than 5 ticks rather than 8 ticks.

steps.text: Complete the final cutscene.

quests.name: Temple of the Eye

chat.text: What's a wizard doing in Al Kharid?

steps.text: Go west through the Al Kharid gate, then run towards the hops patch and purchase a bucket of compost from the farmer Vasquen.

chat.text: Yes, that sounds like a fair price.

steps.text: Run towards south-eastern Varrock, using the fence shortcut along the way, and empty the bucket of compost.
Use the eye amulet on the Mage of Zamorak at the Altar of Chaos in south-eastern Varrock.
Speak to the Tea Seller at the eastern entrance to Varrock.

chat.text: Could I have a strong cup of tea?

steps.text: Run south and enter the gated area in south-eastern Varrock and fill your bucket at the well.

steps.text: Speak to the Dark Mage to receive an abyssal incantation.
Head south-west and enter the fire rift.
Exit the Fire Altar and make your way west to Wizard Persten.

quests.name: Dragon Slayer I
quests.start: Speak to the Guildmaster in the Champions' Guild.

steps.text: If you haven't used the wilderness lever before, use it and select 'do not show this warning', in order to prevent the deep wilderness warning from showing during the speedrun.
Decide whether to use the adamant sword route or the maple shortbow route:
notes: The adamant sword allows constant usage of the anti-dragon shield during the Elvarg fight, but will be slower and cannot be used to kill Wormbrain without spells. Its lower cost compared to the maple shortbow + 50 adamant arrows allows buying Crumble Undead runes, which negates the need to prepare Melzar's Maze for casual runs.

The maple shortbow has a higher damage output and can kill Wormbrain and Melzar's Maze NPCs at range, but requires constantly switching to the anti-dragon shield during the Elvarg fight to not get horribly burnt. The higher cost does not allow for Crumble Undead, making preparing Melzar's Maze highly encouraged (but not required).

steps.text: Optional: Prepare all Melzar's Maze NPCs in advance (kill all except the lesser demon once for their key to go further, then get their Hitpoints as low as possible — they will regenerate to only 50%-60% health by the time you get back in the actual run, saving about a minute and reducing RNG for their kills).
notes: Your unarmed max hit is 6 (7 with Ultimate Strength).
Your max hit with an adamant sword is 8 (9 with Ultimate Strength).
Your max hit with a maple shortbow and adamant arrows is 9 (10 with Eagle Eye).

steps.text: Talk to Guildmaster in Champions' Guild.
Minigame Teleport to Soul Wars, leave via the portal to Edgeville
Go to the Edgeville General Store and buy a hammer, knife and bucket.
Trade with Oziach to skip some initial dialogue.

chat.text: The Guildmaster of the Champions' Guild told me.
I thought you were going to give me a quest.
A dragon, that sounds like fun.

steps.text: Fill your bucket up on the well.
Run to the lever and teleport to the Wilderness. Run to the Mage Arena, cutting webs as you go.
If using a maple shortbow, go to Lundail's Arena-side Rune Shop and buy:
notes: 5 fire runes
15 law runes
50 water runes
100 air runes
10 death runes
10 earth runes

steps.text: If using an adamant sword, go to Lundail's Arena-side Rune Shop and buy:
notes: 5 fire runes
11 law runes
100 water runes
150 air runes
15 death runes
50 earth runes
20 chaos runes

steps.text: Teleport to Varrock, then from Thessalia's Fine Clothes. buy 1 silk.
notes: If choosing to use an adamant sword, buy it from the Varrock Swordshop now (Skip buying the studded armour, bow, and arrows later on).

steps.text: Talk to Guildmaster in Champions' Guild.

chat.text: How can I find the route to Crandor?
Where can I find the right ship?
How can I protect myself from the dragon's breath?

steps.text: Teleport to Lumbridge, go to the roof of the castle and collect 3 logs, then speak to Duke Horacio.

chat.text: I seek a shield that will protect me from dragonbreath.
Elvarg, the dragon of Crandor island!
So, are you going to give me the shield or not?

steps.text: Teleport to Varrock again, drop your knife and remaining fire runes.
notes: Optional: Adamant sword - From Horvik's Armour Shop buy a studded body and studded chaps. Don't equip until after Melzar's Maze.
Maple shortbow - From Horvik's Armour Shop buy a studded body and studded chaps. Equip them.
Maple shortbow - From Lowe's Archery Emporium buy a maple shortbow and 50 adamant arrows. Equip them.

steps.text: Run to the Lumberyard, buy 3 planks and 100 steel nails.
Teleport to Falador, buy a wizard's mind bomb from the Rising Sun Inn
Run to the Estate Agent and buy a house

chat.text: How can I get a house?

steps.text: Teleport outside of your player-owned house, then run north-west to Melzar's Maze, drop the construction guide. Drop the maze key after entering.
Kill the small zombie rat with a long tail (melee/ranged works best) to get the key and enter the north-western door and climb up the ladder.
Kill the ghost wearing a hood, a tube top, and no cape (Crumble Undead works best) to get the key and enter the second door from the north on the eastern wall and climb up the ladder.
Kill the skeleton with the round shield (Crumble Undead works best) to get the key and enter the westmost door on the southern wall and climb down the ladder 3 times.
Kill the zombies (Crumble Undead works best) to get the key and enter the blue door.
Kill Melzar the Mad (melee/ranged works best) to get the key and enter the purple (magenta) door. Consider flicking Eagle Eye/Ultimate Strength + Incredible Reflexes to help kill him faster.
Kill the lesser demon with Water Blast to get the key and enter the green door (finish the kill with melee/ranged if needed). Search the chest for the map part.
Teleport to House, run south-east and take the bronze pickaxe from on top of the table in the building.
notes: Adamant sword - Equip studded body and chaps if purchased earlier.

steps.text: Run north to Rimmington Mine and mine 1 clay, then use your bucket of water on it. Drop the empty bucket and pickaxe.
notes: Maple shortbow - Drop any remaining chaos runes you have.
Adamant sword - Keep the chaos runes to use against Wormbrain, then drop them after grabbing his map part.

steps.text: From Gerrant's Fishy Business, buy a lobster pot.
Run south to the Port Sarim jail. Kill Wormbrain with ranged/bolt spells and Telekinetic Grab his map part.
Talk to Klarense in the southern docks of Port Sarim by the Void Outpost boat and pay him 2,000 coins.
Go on board, climb down the ladder and repair the hole 3 times.
Teleport to Lumbridge, head toward the cemetery while dropping your remaining coins, any remaining nails and your hammer.
Talk to Count Check and have him teleport you

chat.text: Is there somewhere I can learn more about account security?
Yes please, teleport me to the Stronghold of Security.

steps.text: At Barbarian Village use the pottery wheel to make an unfired bowl.
Run to the Oracle on Ice Mountain

chat.text: I seek a piece of the map to the island of Crandor.

steps.text: Enter the Dwarven mine and use silk, lobster pot, unfired bowl, wizard's mind bomb on the magic door at the north-east side of the mine. You should automatically enter the door.
Enter the magic door, open the chest, and search the chest to receive a map part. Press space or ensure that you finish the dialogue.
Teleport to Lumbridge, drop your empty beer glass. Run to Draynor Village.
Talk to Ned with the map in your inventory.
notes: Optional: Consider withdrawing more lobsters from the bank.

chat.text: You're a sailor? Could you take me to Crandor?

steps.text: Teleport to House and return to the boat you previously repaired in Port Sarim. Board the ship and talk to Captain Ned.
Climb on top of the volcano and enter the hole.
Head south and kill Elvarg.
notes: Maple shortbow - Pray Protect from Magic and Eagle Eye, and alternate equipping your shield when Elvarg attacks in between bow shots to avoid taking high damage from the dragonfire. Stepping under her after attacking will give you more time to equip the shield.
Adamant sword - Equip your anti-dragon shield, and pray Protect from Magic, Ultimate Strength, and Incredible Reflexes.
Note: If you are not finished with the fight by 17:50:00, you will have to restart the speedrun.

steps.text: Teleport to Falador as soon as Elvarg dies, before the animation of removing her head. Run to Edgeville.
Talk to Oziach in Edgeville.

quests.name: A Taste of Hope
quests.start: Speak to Garth in Ver Sinhaza by the entrance to the Theatre of Blood.

Talk to Garth.
Run to the Myreque Hideout, taking the rooftop route.
Speak to Safalaan.
Minigame Teleport to the Burthorpe Games Room.
Run to the general store Burthorpe Supplies. Sell the dragon platelegs and buy a chisel.
Run to the Warriors' Guild and buy two attack and two strength potions from Lilly.
Use the Ectophial teleport, then run north and take Andras' boat back to Ver Sinhaza.
Attempt to climb up the rubble west of the bank, within Ver Sinhaza.
Speak to Harpert west of the bank and pay him 1,000 coins.
Climb the rubble and make your way to the north-eastern red window, via climbing vents and jumping off roofs.
Look through the window. (Be sure you complete the dialogue once the cut-scene is finished; your health will be restored upon completing the dialogue.)
Use the Ectophial teleport, then run north and take Andras' boat back to Ver Sinhaza.
Run to the Myreque Hideout, taking the rooftop route.
Return to Safalaan.
Speak to Flaygian Screwte.
Speak to Safalaan.
Go to Serafina's house. (You should have finished a full stamina potion at this point for the next step)
Use an empty vial on the broken fountain.
Climb down the stairs of Serafina's house, south of the fountain.
Speak to Safalaan.
Search the crates and barrels around the basement to obtain mysterious meat, mysterious herb, and a pestle and mortar.
notes: Use the mysterious herb on the vial of water.
Use the pestle and mortar on the mysterious meat.
Use the mysterious crushed meat on the unfinished potion.

steps.text: Use the finished potion on the door.
Speak to Safalaan.
Make the potion again, but this time use the ingredients on the vial of blood instead of a vial of water.
Use the blood potion on the door, open and search the chest to receive the old notes.
Talk to Safalaan with the notes.
Run back to the Myreque Hideout and speak to Safalaan to start a cutscene.
Defeat the abomination.
notes: Use a dose of your attack and strength potions, and pray Ultimate Strength and Incredible Reflexes.

steps.text: Use the Ectophial teleport, then run north and take Andras' boat back to Ver Sinhaza.
Run to Old Man Ral's house, and enter the trapdoor in the northern room.
Speak to Safalaan.
Speak to Vertida Sefalatis.
Read Flaygian's notes.
Search the nearby crates to find a silver sickle (b) and a chain.
Attach the emerald to the sickle to create an emerald sickle (b).
Use the enchant emerald or jade tablet on it.
Use the chain on the Rod of Ivandis to create the Ivandis flail.
Equip the flail and speak to Safalaan.
Make your way to Ver Sinhaza, and resupply at the bank if necessary.
Speak to Kael Forshaw.

Defeat Ranis Drakan. He will use melee and magic attacks that can hit up to 20. He can also cast Blood Barrage, which can heal him for half of the damage dealt. Occasionally, he will charge an attack and explode, hitting up to 30. The damage can be reduced by running away from him when he is charging the attack.
notes: After he reaches 65% and 25% of his health, he'll summon two level 87 vyrewatch and will fly airborne. He will regularly launch blood bombs at your current square, which can hit up to 30; you can simply walk backwards one square to lure the vyrewatch to the affected square, so the bombs hurt them instead.

After killing them, he will go berserk and attack the player. During this last phase, his attacks are much faster and accurate, but only have a max hit of 6. Using Protect from Melee will easily defeat him in the last phase.

steps.text: Speak to Safalaan at Old Man Ral's house.

quests.name: Beneath Cursed Sands

steps.text: Disable the Ava's Accumulator from gathering junk by right-clicking "Commune" on it.
Change the attack style of the Rune Crossbow to "rapid".
Talk to Jamila.
Make your way to Maisa.
Take the spade at the north side of the campsite.
Search the camping equipment by the tent for a tinderbox.
Talk to Maisa.
Talk to a citizen or Menaphite Guard.
Inspect the blocked entry at the Jaltevas Pyramid.
Fight the Head Menaphite Guard with Piety active. Do not use Protect from Melee.
Run back to the campsite, grabbing a bronze pickaxe on the way.
Talk to Maisa until she departs.
South of the campsite, mine 2-3 iron ore and 1 coal.
Use the coal and tinderbox on the furnace in the Ruins of Ullek.
Smelt the iron ore. There is a 50% chance to fail smelting them, in which case you will want to restart the speedrun if you fail to refine all of them.
Search the well to receive a stone tablet. Read it.
Head back down the stairs and head south to the southernmost ritual pillar. Dig on the south side of it.
Open the chest with the passcode "1118513".
Use the iron bar on the furnace.
Go further north to the pillar, and insert the scarab emblem.
Rotate the scarab on the emblem so that it faces downward (pincers facing upward). A 90 degree rotation is 8 clicks.
Climb down the stairs and defeat the two Scarab Mages with melee. Activate Protect from Magic and Piety during the cutscene to skip the dialogue.
Climb down the stairs again.
Avoid the projectiles and pull the levers on the north-east and south-east ends of the room.
Go through the door west of the junction.
Inspect the south-western plaque to get four emblems.
Inspect the north-western plaque and read it.

The solution to the puzzle is different for everyone. Refer to the table on the right to solve this puzzle. The emblems are listed in the same order they are in your inventory. The hints are arranged from north to south.
notes: “[God 1] arrived just before [god 2]...” – Place the emblem corresponding to god 1 in the northernmost urn and the emblem corresponding to god 2 in the centre-north urn.
“To the one that arrived first, he offered [item 1].” – Place the emblem corresponding to item 1 in the centre-south urn.
“The one that was offered [item 2] came from just south...” – Place the emblem corresponding to item 2 in the southernmost urn.

steps.text: Pull the lever to the south-west and continue to the next area.
Speak to the Spirit.
Take the rusty key from the urn in the back of the room.
Hop worlds to leave the dungeon instance quickly. Re-enter the dungeon and open the door on the upper level.
Defeat the Champion of Scabaras with ranged, Protect from Magic, and Eagle Eye. Keep your distance, and destroy the Shadow Rift and Scarab Swarm as they appear.
Talk to the High Priest of Scabaras.
Hop worlds to leave the instance, or simply walk out of the dungeon.
Go to Nardah.
(Optional, but recommended) Resupply at the bank; you will no longer need ranged equipment.
Talk to Maisa or Zahur in the building directly south of the fountain.
Purchase a cooked meat from the Nardah General Store.
notes: You can buy a full inventory of cooked meat and use the extra to heal up from the previous fight.

steps.text: Head west to the island with the lily. Attempt to jump to the stepping stones, and throw the meat to the crocodile.
Pick the Lily of the Elid and use the item on Zahur.
Warm up her chemistry equipment.
notes: Increase the middle bar 15 times, then increase the right bar 15 times, then decrease the right bar 2 times, then decrease the middle bar 2 times.
(If it didn't work, keep decreasing the middle and right bars alternatingly.)

steps.text: Receive the cure crate from Zahur.
Run south-west to the tent west of the Agility Pyramid, and enter the nearby rock to reach Sophanem quicker.
Use the cure crate on the High Priest.
Go to the necropolis and talk to Maisa, located directly south of the south-eastern gate of Sophanem by the bend in the path.
At the end of the cutscene, defeat the Menaphite Akh. The Menaphite Akh attacks using melee, and will occasionally use special attacks.
notes: When she twitches, she will perform a lightning bolt attack and direct it in front of her. This attack can hit 70+ if not evaded. Always be prepared to walk behind or beside her to avoid this attack.

During the fight she will also summon a Menaphite Shadow that attacks with ranged or magic. Run to attack it quickly (but still watch out for the lightning attack). If not killed promptly, the shadow can switch places with the Akh, and the player must attack the real one or suffer large amounts of damage.

steps.text: Go back to Sophanem and talk to Maisa or the High Priest to finish the quest.

Kharedst's memoirs (fully charged, all pages added, including secret page)

Change the attack style of the Rune Crossbow to "rapid".
Set the Grouping menu to teleport to Soul Wars.

Run east to The Deeper Lode pub and speak to Fuggy.

Run south to Veos' ship and speak to Cabin Boy Herbert.
Defeat the Judge of Yama; dodge the fire waves and run to the boss to attack him. Use Protect from Melee.
Go south-west to speak to Commander Fullore outside of the castle until she heads back in.
Use the Grouping menu to teleport to Soul Wars, leave via the portal to Edgeville.
Run to the lever and teleport to the Wilderness. Run to the Mage Arena, cutting webs as you go.
Free up seven inventory spaces, and buy the following runes from Lundail:

20 law
50 fire
50 air
50 earth

steps.text: Cast Lumbridge Teleport and buy a bronze pickaxe and steel axe from Bob.
Use Xeric's talisman and teleport to "Xeric's Heart".
Run east and speak to Martin Holt.

Teleport to the Arceuus Library via the portal nexus.
Teleport to the Archive via Archeio.
Pickpocket Istoria for the bluish key.
Search the pink display case in the south-east corner of the room to retrieve Rose's diary.

Use Rose's diary on Martin.
Read the note and speak to Martin again.

Go to the Settlement Ruins, south-west of Wintertodt. Drop the steel axe on the way.
Speak with Martin in the north-western building.
Kill the assassin that spawns.
Cast Fire Blast on the ice chunks south-west of Martin, search the melted ice chunks and open the panel on the western wall.
Read the note.
Teleport to Port Piscarilius via Kharedst's memoirs.
Run south-west to The Legless Faun pub and speak to Martin.
Climb the pillar behind Martin.
Check the panel upstairs in the northern wall. Note the order of each city.
Go back down the wall and push the statue panels on the statues in the order specified from the panel.
Check the panel upstairs again.
After the cutscene, cast Camelot Teleport, then run south-east to the Catherby docks. Destroy Rose's note and drop your antipoison on the way.
Purchase a chisel, bucket of sand and soda ash from a Trader Crewmember.
Cast Teleport to House, use the Portal Nexus to teleport to Canifis
Run north-east and buy a facemask from Mazchna
Use Xeric's talisman and teleport to "Xeric's Inferno".
Make your way to the lovakite mine at the north-west corner of Lovakengj.
Wear your facemask and head further north to the sulphur mine.
Mine one volcanic sulphur.
Cast Teleport to House then use the Portal Nexus -> Arceuus Library Teleport and run north.
Make your way towards the dense essence mine.
notes: Re-equip the Helm of Neitiznot and drop the facemask on the way.
Swap to the Arceuus spellbook at Tyss (this unlocks the ability to swap spellbooks at home with the Occult altar later).
Use the east shortcut in the final stretch.

Search the south-eastern lizardman eggs.
Cast Battlefront Teleport and run south to Molch and enter the furthest east lizard dwelling.
notes: Equip your ranging equipment on the way there.

steps.text: Use the egg on Kaht b'alam until you get the damp key.
Open the door that is located on the north wall of the main corridor. Go through the door and the gate.
Defeat Xamphur.
notes: Pray Protect from Magic and Eagle Eye.
Kill the Phantom Hands when they spawn.
Avoid the crushing hands when he releases them by walking the entire length of the room north to south.

steps.text: Search the northern table in the lab.
Cast Battlefront Teleport and run north-west.
Return to the shack and speak to Commander Fullore.
Cast Arceuus Library Teleport and run west to the Tower of Magic, then climb upstairs and speak to Lord Trobin Arceuus.
Use Xeric's talisman and teleport to "Xeric's Glade".
Head east to the manor and speak to Lord Kandur Hosidius.
Teleport to Lovakengj via Kharedst's memoirs.

Teleport to Shayzien again via Kharedst's memoirs.

Climb back down and speak to Lord Hosidius.

quests.start: Speak to Veliaf Hurtz outside the church in Slepe.

steps.text: Talk to Veliaf Hurtz.
Talk to Hameln the Jester inside the church.

chat.text: Do you know how he fell ill?

chat.text: Where do you get your Bloody Bracers from?

Return to east of Paterdomus and talk to Ivan.

Use the long vine on the swamp tree branch.
Swing across the water and continue the trek.
Kill the Nail beasts, use food on Ivan if his health becomes too low, and continue the trek.

Exit westwards and purchase the vyrewatch outfit from Trader Sven.
Equip the vyrewatch outfit to minimise the chances of vyrewatch disruption.
Run to the laboratory entrance, using the shortcut doors on the rooftop route.
Head downstairs to the laboratory entrance (south-eastwards from the mine, in the house with the slashed tapestry)
Re-equip your Bandos armour and primordial boots, then talk to Safalaan.
Kill the Mutated Bloodveld.
Talk to Safalaan again.
Search the bookshelf on the western wall inside the room filled with mutated bloodvelds.
Talk to Safalaan.
Teleport to Ver Sinhaza, then exit westwards.
Climb the wall at the south-west corner, climb the floor, and then the rocks to reach the boat.
Board the boat.
Talk to Veliaf at the eastern part of the graveyard.
Teleport to Ver Sinhaza, and go down the trapdoor in Old Man Ral's house to the west.
Talk to Polmafi Ferdygris.
Return to the Icyene Graveyard via the Meiyerditch boat.
Talk to Vanescula Drakan.
Use the ectophial and travel to Slepe via Andras up north.
Wield your Ivandis Flail if you haven't already, and drink a dose of your superantipoison.
Talk to Veliaf at the graveyard.
Kill Damien Leucurte. Use Protect from Magic and Piety, and stomp out the magical fires that periodically spawn.
Talk to Veliaf.
Use the ectophial and travel to Slepe via Andras up north.
Upon arrival, return to the Icyene Graveyard via the other boat.
Talk to Vanescula Drakan.
Wear the vyre noble clothing.
Teleport to Ver Sinhaza.
Bank to clear 8 inventory spaces by depositing your potions and food. Keep the axe.
Ask the vyrewatch by the bank to send you to the mines.
Talk to a Vampyre Juvinate to exit the mine.
Go through the crack north of the mining hole.
Head to the Arboretum. (The tree icon east of the bank in Darkmeyer.)
Finish the dialogue with the guard Desmodus Lasiurus.
Head to the house with a water symbol north-east of the furnace, along the east wall near the crack.
Talk to Mordan Nikazsi.
Head to the prison in the northern part of Darkmeyer, north of the Arboretum.
Talk to Maria Gadderanks.
Talk to Desmodus Lasiurus.
Enter the Arboretum.
Search the toppled shelves for an old note.
Read it, and take note of how many gallons the tree requires to be cut. Set the north and south valve to the given values in accordance to the table below.
Cut eight blisterwood logs.
Use the ectophial and travel to Slepe via Andras up north, then sail back to the Icyene Graveyard via the Slepe dock up north.
Speak to Veliaf/Vanescula.
Teleport to Ver Sinhaza.
Exit westwards, and go down the trapdoor in Old Man Ral's house.
Talk to Vertida Sefalatis and give him 7 Blisterwood logs.
Create the blisterwood flail.
notes: Search the nearby crate for a silver sickle (b).
Use the ruby on the sickle.
Use the enchant ruby or topaz tablet on the ruby sickle (b).
Use the blisterwood log on the enchanted ruby sickle (b).
Use the Ivandis flail on the blisterwood sickle.

steps.text: Teleport to Ver Sinhaza. Withdraw the adamant darts and combat supplies from the bank. Do not deposit your coins.
Use the ectophial and travel to Slepe via Andras up north, then go back to the Icyene Graveyard via the Slepe dock.
Talk to Veliaf Hurtz.
Talk to Safalaan Hallow, north-east of the graveyard.
After the cutscene, kill Vanstrom Klause whilst using Protect from Magic and Piety. He uses three special attacks, doing so every 8-10 attacks, and never uses the same one twice in a row.
notes: "My pets will feast on your corpse!" - Acidic Bloodveld is spawned and will explode on the player for high damage. Use your adamant darts to kill it quickly.
"Blood will be my strength!" - A blood orb spawns that periodically heals Vanstrom. Walking on top of it (3x3 area) damages the player, but Vanstrom can be lured on top to damage him.

"Stare into darkness!" - Heavy damage is taken if the player is facing Vanstrom. The attack gives very little warning and is near impossible to avoid on reaction. It is recommended that the player keep a count of how many attacks Vanstrom has done and turn around preemptively.
After you deplete his health, he will heal himself 200 hitpoints and stop using his special attacks.
Protection prayers are no longer effective; use Piety and Redemption.
Vanstrom summons lightning to strike tiles with a max hit of 46. Tiles that are about to be struck will have a dark circle on them and should be avoided.

steps.text: Watch the cutscene to complete the quest.

quests.name: Dragon Slayer II
quests.start: Speak to Alec Kincade outside the Myths' Guild.
items: • High-tier ranged equipment, including the dragon hunter crossbow

steps.text: Before beginning the speedrun, set up for the quest and use the catspeak amulet to locate Bob the Cat to quickly reach him later during the speedrun.
Talk to Alec Kincade.

chat.text: How can I gain access to the Guild?

steps.text: Use the Teleport to house tablet, then use the portal nexus and press P.
Head inside the Troll Stronghold, and run southwards towards the stone staircase.
Climb down and then climb down the next set of stairs north-east.
Head north to the storeroom and steal one goutweed; use this map for help.
Teleport to your house, then use the ornate jewellery box; Press P to teleport to Karamja.
Head south and talk to Dallas Jones at the Karamja pub at Musa Point.
Head east and drop your sharks.
Purchase the following from a Trader Crewmember: hammer, tinderbox, and x10 swamp paste.
Teleport to your house, then use the portal nexus and press K.
Go to Baba Yaga's Magic Shop and purchase one astral rune, along with 50 of the following runes: air, water, earth, fire, law, blood.

At the Lunar Isle bank, deposit your inventory and withdraw the following items: Teleport runes, coins, house tablets, seal of passage, stamina potion, hammer, swamp paste, catspeak amulet, and lunar staff.
Teleport to your house, then right-click the ornate jewellery box and teleport back to Karamja.
Go to Elvarg's lair under Crandor. Before climbing over the wall, grab the pickaxe from the nearby rock.
Climb over into Elvarg's lair and talk to Dallas.
Right-click use the bronze pickaxe on the blockage in the northern wall of the room, then enter the tunnel.
Drop the bronze pickaxe.
Investigate the Ancient Mural by the pool. Kill the spawn.
Investigate the mural again.
Talk to Dallas.
Teleport to your house, and use the mounted digsite pendant in the portal nexus room to teleport to the House on the Hill.
Climb down the trapdoor and talk to Dallas.

chat.text: So how do we know which island to go to?

steps.text: Drop enough items to have 24 free inventory spaces (you will pick them back up later).
Search the open chest north of the map for 5 pieces.
Go upstairs, search the open stone chest on the north wall for 3 pieces.
Climb back up, then climb down the west staircase. Search the fungi directly north of it for 4 pieces.
Search the hook briar directly north of the bridge for 7 pieces.
Run all the way east and search the large mushtree for 5 pieces.
Talk to Dallas Jones until he takes the map pieces, then pick up your items from the floor.
Solve the map puzzle; click to rotate, drag to swap.
Cast Lumbridge Teleport, and purchase a steel axe from Bob's Brilliant Axes.
Teleport to your house, then use the digsite pendant to teleport to the digsite
Run to the sawmill then chop the oak trees nearby for eight oak logs.
Head to the Sawmill Operator and purchase a saw and 50 steel nails.
Make 8 oak planks via the Buy-plank option on the Sawmill Operator.
Teleport to house then fairy ring to ALP.
Walk into the lighthouse and go up to the 1st floor
Trade Jossik and purchase a pestle and mortar.
Teleport to your house, and use the mounted digsite pendant to teleport to the Digsite.
Run east and select the "Quick-Travel" option on the barge guard.
Talk to Jardric at the Museum Camp.
Run north-west to the rowboat space ( map icon) and build the boat.
Talk to Dallas and board the boat.
Drop your steel axe, saw, and any extra nails.
Head north-west from the boat to the ruined courtyard, and climb up the western stairs.
Climb down the trapdoor to the south, down the staircase to the north, and north down another staircase.
Talk to Dallas.
Search the skeleton to the east and read Aivas' diary.
Talk to Dallas again. Drop the diary.

images.file: Dragon Slayer II map puzzle solution.png
images.caption: The solved map puzzle.

steps.text: Teleport out and search for and speak to Bob the Cat.
notes: It helps to pre-scout his location before starting the run. You can use the catspeak amulet(e) to help find him.

steps.text: Teleport to your house, then use the Spiritual Fairy Tree code DLQ.
Run south-west to the tent west of the Agility Pyramid, and enter the nearby rock to reach Sophanem.
Talk to the Sphinx.

chat.text: Ask the Sphinx for help with Bob's memories.

steps.text: Teleport to your house, then use the portal nexus and press K.
Destroy the catspeak amulet.
Head to the Oneiromancer and talk to her.
Teleport to your house, then use the portal nexus and press K.
Withdraw the following items from the bank: astral rune, tinderbox, goutweed, ghostspeak amulet, dragonstone, ectophial, and combat supplies. Swap your abyssal whip with Sarachnis cudgel.
Fill the dream vial with water in the building west of the bank.
Crush the astral rune with the hammer, then grind the astral rune shards with the pestle and mortar.
Use the goutweed and ground astral rune on the dream vial.
Drop the pestle and mortar.
Use the tinderbox on the Ceremonial Brazier and use the dream potion on it.
Talk to Not Bob.
Defeat Robert the Strong.
notes: He can hit heavy damage through Protect from Missiles but it reduces damage taken. Using piety is recommended to speed up the fight, as the most challenging part about this fight is lasting long enough through the damage taken.
When he shouts "See if you can hide from this!", run behind one of the pillars to avoid his special attack. If it hits you, it can deal up to 60 damage and will knock off your prayers.

steps.text: Talk to Bob after exiting the dream.
Teleport to your house, then use the portal nexus and press 9.
Purchase the following from a Trader Crewmember in the Catherby dock: 1 glassblowing pipe, 2 soda ash, 2 buckets of sand
Charter a ship to Brimhaven.
Exit the docks and travel to Shilo Village via Hajedy.
Purchase a spade and candle from Obli's General Store just west. Light the candle and drop your tinderbox.
Right-click "Coffer" on the village furnace and deposit 40 coins.
Make two pieces of molten glass at the furnace eastward.

chat.text: Pay 20 coins and don't ask again.

steps.text: If you need more food/stamina, withdraw them from the bank.
Exit the village and climb the vine agility shortcut east of the entrance.
Run south-east towards the Karamjan Temple.
Take the key piece from the plinth.
Cast Varrock Teleport and make your way to Reldo in the Varrock Castle library.
Search the second bookcase from the north on the west side of the central row (see picture).
Use the Varrock census records on Reldo.
Go to Port Phasmatys and speak to Sarah, west of the bank.
Teleport to your house, then use the mounted xeric's talisman in the portal nexus and press 1. Use the restoration pool if needed.
Run west to the Graveyard of Heroes and enter the Shayzien Crypts. Drop your ghostspeak amulet.
Head to the bottom of the crypt and inspect the tomb to find the puzzle.
The solution to the puzzle is different for everyone. Refer to the table below to solve this puzzle.
notes: "The one from [Location] sat at the north of the table": Place this statue north.
"Opposite the one with [Weapon]": Place this statue south.
"The one with [Weapon] asked the.....": Place this statue west.
Place the final statue east.

steps.text: Search the tomb to get the dragon key piece.
Teleport to your house, then use the portal nexus and press B to get to Draynor Manor. Drop your candle.
Make your way to Ava in Draynor Manor.

chat.text: I need your help with a key piece.

steps.text: Use your glassblowing pipe on your dragonstone and use the inert locator orb on Ava to get a locator orb.
Teleport to your house, then use the Spiritual Fairy Tree code BKR.
Use the locator to find the buried key piece; the location is randomised every time the player resets the speedrun.

The closest teleport to most of the dig spots is the BKR fairy ring. CKR and BIP are marginally faster to get to one dig spot each, but it's not worth using them. ALQ can save 30 seconds getting to a single dig spot, the leftmost magenta one.
notes: Start at BKR and feel your locator device.
If you get north-east, it will always be the lone purple spot that you need to cross the bridge to get to.

If you get south-west, south, or south-east, go to the centre of the subdivided area and scan again. For example, if you got west, go to the centre of the blue subdivision and scan there again. If you get west again, you've narrowed it down to a single dig spot.

If you get east, you want to figure out if going to ALQ would be faster. To do this, move a bit south-east to the centre of the black subdivision and scan. If it says north-east, go back to the BKR fairy ring and teleport to ALQ. Otherwise, run south-east and get to the centre of the magenta subdivision.

steps.text: Teleport to your house, then use the portal nexus and press K.
At the bank, deposit the seal of passage, locator orb, glassblowing pipe, spade, and ectophial.
notes: You can bank at the eastern stall even without a seal of passage.

steps.text: Withdraw the blood runes, ranged equipment, salve amulet(ei), antivenom, and additional supplies.
Talk to the Sirsal Banker and get kicked out to Rellekka.
Make your way to Brundt the Chieftain.
Head north to Torfinn and sail to Ungael.
Defeat Vorkath.
notes: Use ruby bolts (e) until he has 150 hp, then switch to diamond bolts (e).
The death spawn only deals around 20 damage - you can shoot it with a bolt or just tank it.
Near the end of the fight, start moving to the north side of the arena.

steps.text: Climb over the ice chunks in the north of the crater and walk along the path to the north-west of the island to enter the laboratory.
Pull the lever in the south-west section, then run to the room on the east wall.
Search the stone chest for a dragon key piece and an ancient key.
Teleport to your house, then use the ornate jewellery box; Press 6 to teleport to the Barbarian Outpost.
Go to the Ancient Cavern by running south to the whirlpool.
Descend the stairs and run south to another set of stairs which lead to the to the mithril dragon area.
Run west and open the mithril door in the middle of the area (with the three mithril dragons clumped together).
Cast Fire Wave on the three dragon heads.
Leave the room and go east down the staircase, and then go to the south-western area of the caverns, and climb up the rough hewn steps there.
Use one of the anvils here to forge the dragon key.
Teleport to your house, and use the mounted digsite pendant in the portal nexus room to teleport to the House on the Hill.
Use the Magic Mushtree to get to 4. Mushroom Meadow, then run to the boat you repaired earlier.
Return to Dallas on Lithkren. Use the dragon key on the ancient doors.
Enter the doors, head up north, and talk to Dallas to start the cutscene.
After the cutscene, make sure Jardric and Bob depart before continuing.

images.file: Dragon Slayer II - Karamjan Temple maze route.png
images.caption: The route to the centre of the temple's maze. This map is flipped, making the top part south, and bottom part north.

images.file: Dragon Slayer II - Morytania key piece dig strategy.png
images.caption: A map of possible key piece locations, which splits Mort Myre Swamp into 6 sections, starting at the BKR fairy ring, then further subdivides sections past that.

steps.text: Cast Varrock Teleport and make your way north to King Roald.
Cast Falador Teleport and make your way south towards White Knights' Castle.
Climb up the western staircase and then another, then speak to Sir Amik Varze.
Cast Ardougne Teleport and make your way west towards Ardougne Castle.
Climb up the staircase, then speak to King Thoros.
Teleport to your house, then use the portal nexus and press K.
Talk to the Sirsal Banker and get kicked out to Rellekka. If Bouquet Mac Hyacinth is closer (on the east side of the bank), talk to her instead.
Make your way to Brundt the Chieftain.
Return to Varrock and enter the dining room north of the throne room.
Talk to Bob after exiting the dining room.
Teleport to your house, then use the portal nexus and press K.
At the bank, deposit your inventory and withdraw ranged combat supplies.
notes: Bring one house tab to teleport out after Galvek.
Bring all three types of bolts. It is the best damage on average to use runite bolts for all of the weaker dragons up until the black dragon, then switch to ruby and diamond bolts (e).
Ruby bolts (e) are stronger until each dragon is at about 150hp, at which point diamond bolts (e) become stronger.
Bring an antivenom for the adamant dragon.
Leave four spaces open for the ship ride.

steps.text: Talk to the Sirsal Banker and get kicked out to Rellekka.
Talk to Torfinn.
Hold off the assault on your ship for 4 minutes.
notes: Click leaks to fill them.
Click fires to douse them.
Click injured Fremennik warriors to heal them.
Click damaged masts to repair them.

steps.text: Make your way towards Varrock's grand ship, fighting a red dragon, iron dragon, and brutal green dragon on the way.
Kill the two green and two blue dragons battling the Varrockian soldiers.
notes: Starting with the black dragon, switch to ruby and diamond bolts (e).

steps.text: Kill the black, steel, and brutal red dragons that arrive on the ship one at a time.
notes: When Galvek does a casting animation, run away from your current location.
Use protect from melee and stand in melee distance for the black and steel dragons, then switch back to protect from magic.

steps.text: Kill the mithril, adamant, and rune dragons that arrive on the ship one at a time.
notes: These three dragons have a melee, ranged, magic, and dragonfire attack.
The adamant dragon also has two special attacks:
A ranged attack with the Blood Forfeit effect (hits through Protect from Missiles).
A poison attack that splashes and lands on nearby squares dealing lots of damage. Drink antivenom to lessen the damage.
The rune dragon also has two special attacks:
A ranged attack with the Life Leech effect (hits through Protect from Missiles).
An electric attack that hits nearby squares and arcs around the player, dealing rapid damage.

steps.text: Kill Galvek - he has four phases that have 300 hitpoints each.
notes: Keep avoiding his ground-targeted fireballs.
Turn your prayers back on after his pink dragonfire knocks them off.
Setting your quick prayers to Protect from Magic and Eagle Eye is beneficial to counter this attack.
Use Protect from Magic in phase 1, use Protect from Missiles in phases 2, 3 and 4.

Phase 1: Drops eight fire traps- don't get near them or you will be hit for all your health. Stay along the north side of the ship, one square directly south of Galvek, and run two squares south from your location to avoid the fireball, and return to your original position once the attack has failed to hit you.
Phase 2: Launches transparent projectile which drains stats, especially run energy.
Phase 3: Summons waves from either the north or south end, avoid them by standing in the gap. Turn off auto retaliate to not get pulled away from the gap.
Phase 4: Launches earth projectiles. Avoid these or you will be bound, and probably die.

steps.text: Teleport to your house, then use the Spiritual Fairy Tree.
Return to Alec Kincade outside the Myths' Guild to finish the quest.
